name: CreateAIDBClusterDataset

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI database cluster. The cluster must have DBType set to polardb_ai. This parameter is required. If it is not provided, the service returns InvalidDBClusterId.Malformed (404)
parameters.help_zh: AI 数据库集群 ID，必须指向 DBType=polardb_ai 的集群。此参数实际为必填项；未提供时，服务返回 InvalidDBClusterId.Malformed（404）
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The dataset type. Valid values:
train: training dataset
eval: evaluation dataset
parameters.help_zh:
数据集类型，取值如下：
train：训练集
eval：评测集
parameters.name: dataset_type

parameters.help_en:
The training mode for the dataset. Dataset formats vary by mode. Valid values:
sft: supervised fine-tuning, dedicated to training datasets
grpo: reinforcement learning optimization, dedicated to training datasets
text: text generation, dedicated to validation datasets
parameters.help_zh:
数据集应对的训练模式，不同模式的数据集格式存在差异，取值如下：
sft：监督微调，训练集专用
grpo：强化学习优化，训练集专用
text：文本生成，验证集专用
parameters.name: train_mode

parameters.help_en:
The import method. Valid values:
LocalImport: local import
parameters.help_zh:
导入方式，取值如下：
LocalImport：本地导入
parameters.name: import_mode

DBClusterId.description_en: The instance ID of the PolarDB database for the AI model service
DBClusterId.description_zh: AI模型服务的PolarDB数据库实例ID

DataServiceId.description_en: The instance ID of the dataset management service
